title: Apple Chutney
description: Sweet-tangy apple chutney, great with pork, cheese boards, or curry night.
ingredients: 4 medium apples, peeled and diced (tart, such as Granny Smith)
instructions: In a saucepan, combine 4 medium apples (peeled and diced), 1 medium yellow onion (diced), 3/4 cup (180 ml) apple cider vinegar, 1/2 cup (120 ml) maple syrup, 1/3 cup (48g) raisins, 1 tbsp fresh ginger (minced), 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1/2 tsp mustard seeds, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp red chili flakes (optional).
Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to a low simmer.
Simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally (more often near the end) until thick, jammy, and most of the liquid has reduced.
Remove from heat, cool to room temperature, then transfer to a jar and refrigerate.
notes: Macros are per 1/6 batch (~3 tbsp serving as a condiment, not a meal). Maple syrup used in place of the original brown sugar per your standing sweetener preference. This is carb-heavy and protein-negligible by design — it's a condiment, not something to lean on for your protein/fat targets.
